introHeading: See the world through trusted reports
introLead: Jendela Dunia gathers recent reports from reliable media and public sources, organizes them by topic and continent, and groups related coverage so readers can follow major events without wading through repeated headlines.
introCard1Text: News is collected from established media, institutions and specialist outlets.
introCard2Text: Each continent has its own feed, while Global highlights the hottest stories overall.
introCard3Text: Similar reports are grouped together so the main feed stays cleaner.
introCard4Text: Open the original article and compare related coverage when needed.
